column1: # phoneme_costs.tsv - data-driven substitution costs for PhonemeMatcher (S6-MATCHER, M-1).
# Source: ipa/out.confusion_empirical/substitution_matrix.tsv (M2E E-3, 872 sub pairs with count_nod>0;
# Direction (WO D2): row (heard,target) = cost of matching heard token h against template token t,
#   i.e. the edit script heard->target; template token t realized as heard token h costs cost(h,t).
#   Out-of-table substitutions cost 1.0 (equal weight); identity (h==t) costs 0.
# Normalization (WO D2, cost in [0.1,1]): p_sub = P(heard|target), per-target-column share of
#   count_nod (voice_dialect excluded); cost = clamp(0.1 + 0.9*(-ln p_sub)/(-ln p_min), 0.1, 1.0)
#   with p_min=0.001057 (weakest observed pair -> 1.0 = equal weight; strongest p=1.0000 -> 0.1 floor).
# Insertion/deletion is NOT in this table: flat 0.6 x baseline (WO D3 v0 constant).
# symbols the wav2vec2-era M2E matrix never observed as HEARD tokens. Each
# engine-swap decision per work order C1 (equivalence class OR explicit
#   r -> ɹ, g -> ɡ   IpaText equivalence classes (matching space), not rows here
#   ▁ (U+2581)       word-boundary marker, stripped by the engine before matching
#   ʔ                no template adjacency: stays out-of-table (flat default 1.0)
#   the rest         explicit rows below at the DEFAULT substitution cost 1.0
#                    rows make the coverage explicit and throw nothing)
